questions.title: Bubble Sort Mechanism
questions.description: How does bubble sort reorder a list?
questions.Option1: It selects the smallest element and places it at the front each pass
questions.Option2: It inserts each element into its correct place in a sorted prefix
questions.Option3: It splits the list into halves and merges them
questions.Option4: It repeatedly swaps adjacent elements that are out of order

questions.title: Selection Sort Mechanism
questions.description: How does selection sort work?
questions.Option1: It finds the minimum of the unsorted part and swaps it into the next sorted position
questions.Option2: It swaps every adjacent out-of-order pair repeatedly
questions.Option3: It inserts each new element into a sorted prefix
questions.Option4: It merges two sorted halves of the list

questions.title: Insertion Sort Mechanism
questions.description: How does insertion sort build its result?
questions.Option1: By finding the maximum and moving it to the end each pass
questions.Option2: By taking each element and inserting it into its correct spot in the already-sorted prefix
questions.Option3: By dividing the list and merging the halves
questions.Option4: By swapping random pairs until the list is sorted

questions.title: Snippet Insertion Step
questions.description: Inserting key = nums[2] into the sorted prefix. What does this print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [2, 4, 1]
key = nums[2]
j = 1
while j >= 0 and nums[j] > key:
    nums[j + 1] = nums[j]
    j -= 1
nums[j + 1] = key
print(nums)

questions.title: Snippet Early-Exit Passes
questions.description: What does this program print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = [2, 3, 1]
changed = True
passes = 0
while changed:
    changed = False
    passes += 1
    for j in range(len(nums) - 1):
        if nums[j] > nums[j + 1]:
            nums[j], nums[j + 1] = nums[j + 1], nums[j]
            changed = True
print(passes, nums)
